{{Otheruses|Proctor}}
'''Chief Technical Proctor''' was a staff position at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Gandl Vorkosigge]] held the position during the time [[Cadet/Legends|Cadets]] [[Mako Spince]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were studying at the academy.
